title: host suites compiling vendored monocypher need -Wno-error=conversion for gcc-14 builds
description: Companion to v1bd (which fixed coap_slot_claim + schnorr48). Other host CMake suites that compile lichen/subsys/lichen/crypto/monocypher*.c directly will trip the same -Werror=conversion under gcc-14 (e.g. monocypher.c:1740) unless they add the per-source set_source_files_properties -Wno-error=conversion exclusion (mirroring the Zephyr build's project-wide flag). Sweep lichen/tests/*/CMakeLists.txt for monocypher sources and apply the two-line exclusion where missing.
close_reason: Already covered, verify-and-close (no code change, codereview N/A). The generic monocypher exemption in test_common.cmake lichen_test_target (118b1b29a6, 2026-08-30 17:54 PDT — ~8h BEFORE this bead was filed) applies per-source -Wno-conversion (stronger than the requested -Wno-error=conversion) to any monocypher* source on the target. Coverage audit: all 9 host suites compiling monocypher (capability_announce, coap_slot_claim, l2_key_selection, pubkey_to_iid, rpl_dao_auth, rpl_root_sig, schnorr48, schnorr48_interop, tunnel_auth) list monocypher in SOURCES before calling lichen_test_target, so the exemption reaches every one. Built all 9 under gcc-13.3.0 (same -Wconversion class as gcc-14): 8/9 BUILD-OK; l2_key_selection fails for an UNRELATED reason — lichen_link_rx.c uses CONFIG_LICHEN_SCHC-gated schc_failures unconditionally (broken since 1839a4279d), filed as P1 project-LICHEN-worker6-07ki. Non-host suites: app_identity_rollback/coap_keys_lifecycle/replay_persist are Zephyr tests covered by the project-wide -Wno-error=conversion (lichen/zephyr/CMakeLists.txt:71); fuzz does not enable -Wconversion. The explicit per-suite exclusions in coap_slot_claim:76 and schnorr48:47 (v1bd) are now redundant-but-harmless duplicates of the generic exemption.
